title: THREADS UNDER SKIN
lore: A seamstress pulls silver thread from beneath her skin.
offers: Lose 9 HP. Give one card Retain.
Pay 35 Gold. One Attack or Skill draws an extra card, but Exhausts.

title: FORGE OF WHISPERS
lore: Three hammers argue over the shape of your next mistake.
offers: Pay 30 Gold. One Attack gains +2 base damage per hit.
Lose 10 HP. One Block-granting card gains +4 base Block.
Pay 65 Gold and lose 5 HP. A fixed-cost Attack plays twice, but costs 1 more Energy.

title: PAPER SAINT
lore: The saint offers to fold a piece of your life into a card.
offers: Lose 4 maximum HP. One Attack or Skill costs 1 less Energy, but Exhausts. Keep at least 25 maximum HP.

title: GRAVE ENGRAVER
lore: The engraver has space for one more word on your weapon.
offers: Lose 3 maximum HP. One Attack gains +2 base damage per hit. Keep at least 25 maximum HP.
Pay 25 Gold. Give one card Retain.
Lose 8 HP. One Attack or Skill draws an extra card, but Exhausts.

title: RED COMMUNION
lore: A cup of living iron waits beside a bowl of clean water.
offers: Lose 8 HP. Next combat only: gain 3 Strength and begin with 2 Vulnerable.

title: SALT CHAPEL
lore: White salt has preserved every kneeling pilgrim except you.
offers: Heal 28 HP. Begin your next combat with 2 Weak.
Pay 15 Gold. Begin your next combat with 12 extra Block.

title: LEECH GARDEN
lore: Pale leeches grow inside glass fruit. The gardener smiles.
offers: Lose 5 maximum HP, then heal to full. Keep at least 25 maximum HP.
Lose 9 HP. Gain two random unlocked potions. Requires two empty belt slots.

title: GLASS HEART
lore: A second heartbeat sounds from an unbroken glass chest.
offers: Gain 12 maximum HP and heal 12. Add an unplayable Injury to your deck.
Pay 40 Gold to remove one card.

title: RELIQUARY OF DEBTS
lore: The dead kept careful accounts. Three debts remain unpaid.
offers: Pay 65 Gold. Receive this other relic.
Pay 20 Gold. Gain one random unlocked potion.

title: THE STILL ROOM
lore: An alchemist can distill more than medicine from your belt.
offers: Pay 20 Gold and trade your first potion to upgrade one chosen card.
Trade your first two potions. Gain 8 maximum HP and heal 8.
Lose every carried potion. Gain 18 Gold for each potion sold.

title: BONE ORCHARD
lore: Two pale fruits bear the memories of warriors buried below.
offers: Pay 45 Gold. Receive the shown Rare card.
Lose 7 HP. Receive the shown upgraded Uncommon card.

title: WAR DRUM
lore: A drum of stretched hide beats in time with your pulse.
offers: Pay 25 Gold. Gain 3 Strength for your next combat only.
Lose 6 HP. Draw 2 extra cards in your next opening hand, up to the hand limit.

title: TAX ON BREATH
lore: The collector accepts either blood now or coin for shelter.
offers: Pay 50 Gold. Heal 25 HP and begin your next combat with 12 extra Block.

title: THE FACELESS DRAFTER
lore: The stranger erases a face from a card and offers you the pen.
offers: Pay 20 Gold. Replace one card with a different random Uncommon from your character. Its old upgrade and modifier are lost.
Gain 15 Gold. Your deck stays the same.

title: CANDLE FOR A STRANGER
lore: A stranded soul needs a little warmth to find the road.
offers: Lose 6 HP. Next combat only: gain 2 Strength and begin with 10 extra Block.
